tpl.title: Document templates
tpl.description: The texts of letters, certificates and other printed documents. A template has versions: the active one is used, a new one starts as a draft, and nothing changes until you activate it. There is one template for each language. A template uses names from the record it prints, such as '{{ employee.name }}'.
tpl.denied: You may not see the document templates.
tpl.loadError: The document templates could not be loaded.
tpl.empty.body: No template has been added yet.
tpl.list.title: Templates
tpl.pick.body: Open a template to see its versions and its text.
tpl.letterhead.none: No letterhead applies to this language. A shared part with the code letterhead wraps the letter.
tpl.letterhead.part: This is the letterhead. It wraps every letter in this language: keep '{{ content }}' where the letter's text should appear.
tpl.versions.title: Versions
tpl.readonly: This version is {status} and cannot be edited. Start a new draft from it to change the text.
tpl.body.help: Plain text or HTML with names in double braces, such as '{{ employee.name }}'.
tpl.placeholders: Names you can use (press one to add it to the text)
tpl.placeholders.none: No module has made this record type printable yet, so no names are offered.
tpl.placeholder.salary: (salary: needs a special right to print)
tpl.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved.
tpl.preview.title: Preview
tpl.preview.fields: {count, plural, =0 {The text uses no names.} one {The text uses 1 name:} other {The text uses # names:}}
tpl.preview.pdf: Open the PDF preview in a new tab
tpl.preview.nopdf: This output is not a PDF; the text was checked and rendered without error.
tpl.preview.note: The preview uses invented sample values; nothing is stored.
tpl.activate.title: Activate version {n}?
tpl.activate.effect: From now on this version is used for every new document. The version that was active becomes retired; documents already produced do not change.
tpl.retire.title: Take this template out of use?
tpl.retire.effect: No new document can be made from it. Documents already produced do not change.
tpl.retired: The template is out of use.
tpl.variant: Start a version in the other language
tpl.new.code.help: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.
tpl.new.entity.empty: No module offers a printable record yet.
